meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 每次执行 Bash 命令（如 git、cargo、pytest 等）时，输出会自动经过 rtk 压缩，可节省 60–90% 的 token 用量。rtk 二进制会安装到主机并挂载进容器，无需额外配置。
howto.when: 当 Claude 调用 Bash 工具运行命令（如 git、cargo、pytest 等）时，钩子会自动拦截并交给 rtk 处理。

say.note: 这条命令会被 rtk 压缩输出。
测试输出经 rtk 过滤后返回。

say.text: 列出所有 docker 容器
say.note: 等效于 docker ps，输出被压缩。

howto.what_en: After installation, whenever Claude executes a Bash command (e.g., git, cargo, pytest), the output is automatically filtered through rtk, saving 60–90% of tokens. The rtk binary is installed on the host and mounted into containers without extra config.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever Claude runs a command via the Bash tool (e.g., git, cargo, pytest). The PreToolUse hook intercepts the call and routes it through rtk.

say_en.note: Output will be compressed by rtk.
Test output will be filtered through rtk.
Equivalent to docker ps, output compressed.
